row.notes: If the sender (+0xd2a0) exists: calls Game_TelemetryUdp_SendAllSessionHistory, then fills the Final Classification packet (id 8) per car (46 bytes each): position, laps, grid position, points, pit stops, result status, best lap ms (sec*1000), total race time (double), penalties time, penalty count (from +0xd218 list), tyre stint count and actual/visual compound and end-lap arrays (up to 8). Car count from *(+0xd1d8)+0x108. Sends 0x46e bytes, or down-converts to 0x412 / 0x3fc byte layouts (22 cars) when the UDP format global 0x14607b970 is 1 / 0. Good hook for race results.
